Brøndby is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatments across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. 

Specifically, Brøndby's data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) therapy [^src1]. The inclusion of Brøndby and other municipalities in this detailed breakdown underscores the report's function as a vital tool for local quality development, benchmarking, and clinical oversight within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Because the available corpus data for Brøndby is limited to this single tabular mention, no further historical or relational details are currently documented.
